message.content: Comments in this codebase use lowercase with square-bracket annotations to maintain a consistent, machine-readable format that integrates seamlessly with our build and type-checking pipeline. The lowercase style avoids collision with variable names and function calls, while the square-bracket annotations (e.g., `-[type]` or `-[description]`) provide structured metadata that our static analysis tools can parse to generate documentation, type hints, and inline error messages. This convention also creates a clear visual distinction between executable logic and explanatory metadata, making the codebase more scannable for human readers while remaining fully compatible with automated tooling that consumes the annotation schema.
